findings.title: Dense header and field actions invite adjacent mis-taps
acceptance: Measured external gaps are≥8dp in native screenshots/hierarchy.
320dp layout reflows without reducing target sizes or spacing.
findings.limitations: FIXED; requires current Android XML/bounds at320/360/412/768dp before VERIFIED.

findings.title: Large type on a narrow screen clips the role and spills the gate icon
acceptance: At320dp width and150% type, full role is readable and no icon/text crosses its target.
All tab labels remain distinguishable; inspect at200% separately.
findings.limitations: FIXED; actual native font150/200%, keyboard and safe-area matrix still pending.

findings.title: Raw enums and mixed language leak into operational screens
acceptance: Each currently observed enum renders a Vietnamese business label on list/detail/confirmation screens.
Known backend English notification templates are localized or clearly marked language-specific.
findings.limitations: Known/custom presentation tested from real source; native list/detail screenshots pending.

findings.title: Seal checks still ask for damage severity
acceptance: Seal and condition checks show relevant fields/copy only.
Damage surveys retain their current severity choices and submitted notes.
findings.limitations: Mode-switch payload fixture; native flow/popup pending.

findings.title: Inspection history starts with a false empty message
acceptance: Under a delayed GET, history shows loading rather than empty.
Under a failed GET, history shows a local retry; successful empty/populated results are distinct.
findings.limitations: Delayed/rejected source component fixtures; native slow/offline behavior pending.

findings.title: Unread total is passed but never rendered
acceptance: Native header/content shows the server unread count for zero and nonzero states.
Mark-read actions update the displayed count; verify with authorized fixture state.
findings.limitations: Zero/nonzero/count failures fixtures; native notification integration pending.

findings.title: Booking date requires a manually formatted timestamp
acceptance: User can enter a valid date/time without recalling separators.
Helper/timezone remains visible after entry and validation points to this field.
findings.limitations: Expo-compatible9.1.0 installed; native picker/cancel/timezone not yet exercised this run.

findings.title: Theme selection resets to light when the session reloads
acceptance: Choose dark, close/reopen the app and retain dark with the existing auth session.
Initial unconfigured appearance follows the selected documented default/system preference.
findings.limitations: Storage/bootstrap fixtures; native cold-launch light/dark screenshots pending.

findings.title: Missing-field error remains after both survey fields are filled
acceptance: Blank review produces clear field-specific messages.
Filling each required field removes its missing-field error before another submit; server failures remain visible.
findings.limitations: Actual screen source fixture; native focus/keyboard/TalkBack error read pending.

findings.title: Shared card headings are plain Text without heading semantics
acceptance: TalkBack heading navigation reaches each meaningful card/title once in logical order.
Ordinary content and controls remain individually reachable.
findings.limitations: Static/component semantics verified; actual TalkBack traversal and spoken output UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Supporting operational text falls below contrast threshold
acceptance: Recompute the four named pairs at 375/768/1440px; all >=4.5:1.
Validate representative rendered pixels and exclude decoration, obscured background content and unsupported effects.
findings.limitations: Computed Color4/ancestor alpha; opacity, images and obscured pixels remain separately scoped.

findings.title: Yard map search has no visible keyboard focus
acceptance: Shift+Tab then Tab into map search; a visible ring appears without layout shift.
Search remains keyboard usable and the ring is not clipped.
findings.limitations: Actual native browser Tab: solid2px outline, focus-visible true; see screenshot.

findings.title: Two create dialogs discard input before the save result arrives
acceptance: Delay a save in a disposable fixture: keep panel and values until outcome.
Reject save: show actionable local error, preserve all input, allow retry.
Resolve save: reset/close only after success and show confirmation.
findings.limitations: Actual components in deferred/rejected fixtures plus real browser duplicate/save evidence.

findings.title: Several required-field failures silently return and cannot identify the field
acceptance: Submit blank required values: visible error names each missing field and focus lands on first invalid field.
Invalid email uses type=email or equivalent accessible validation; phone uses type=tel where applicable.
Correcting input clears its stale error; error text is linked with aria-describedby and invalid state.
findings.limitations: Fixture and native browser validation; actual screen-reader announcements pending.

findings.title: Role/permission buttons expose selection only through color
acceptance: Accessibility tree exposes true/false selected state for every toggle.
Keyboard selection updates the state and visible styling together.
If a full tablist is adopted, implement its complete roles and keyboard behavior rather than roles alone.
findings.limitations: Actual component semantics; keyboard selection rechecked in retained regression suite.

findings.title: Gate Pass detail contradicts expiration and cancellation status
acceptance: Fixture ACTIVE fresh/ACTIVE expired/USED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED cases: list and detail status agree.
Expired/cancelled passes have appropriate recovery text and no active Gate-out invitation.
Container 360 validity claim also considers expiry; backend remains authoritative.
findings.limitations: Expired/cancelled/used/boundary and refreshed-expired fixtures; Android scan pending.

findings.title: Container 360 displays an icon where it promises a Gate Pass QR code
acceptance: Decode QR in both screens in a disposable fixture; decoded value equals the same qrToken.
No token/permission: display honest unavailable text and a route to dedicated Gate Pass.
Keep a readable code alternative and expiration guidance.
findings.limitations: Real backend-ready synthetic lifecycle, real Container360 QR screenshot; OpenCV decoded value SHA256 equals backend token. Test pass cancelled afterward; token text is not in the report.

findings.title: Container Gate Pass tab calls unknown readiness a failed condition
acceptance: Pending/read failure/no result/blockers/pass each produce distinct truthful content.
A network error never becomes a claimed failed business condition.
Issue remains unavailable until an explicit backend pass.
findings.limitations: Deferred old responses cannot enable a newly selected visit; API readiness also tested on isolated DB.

findings.title: Movement Order default expiry shifts the local clock by seven hours
acceptance: Freeze a clock in UTC+07 and inspect the default: exactly 24h later, not 17h.
Edit local datetime and verify serialized ISO denotes that local clock time.
Blank/invalid/past dates show a recoverable error and do not submit.
findings.limitations: Calendar, timezone and invalid date fixtures; API persisted dates inspected.

findings.title: Work Queue handover review passes the wrong identifier kind
acceptance: With two distinct handovers, opening the second review task selects the second correct handover.
No matching target displays a missing/unavailable-target state rather than silently selecting the first record.
Prefer retaining canonical entityId in work-queue mapping if a visit can have multiple handovers.
findings.limitations: Backend does not currently produce HANDOVER_REVIEW; no invented producer.

findings.title: Create Truck Visit shortcut drops its container context and opens no form
acceptance: Authorized Movement Order shortcut opens create with the correct container prefilled.
Gate-in shortcut selects the relevant visit and matching arrived truck when unambiguous.
Missing or multiple matching targets have explicit selection/recovery; no write occurs on navigation.
findings.limitations: Actual component fixture; no write on navigation.

findings.title: Screen/context selections are memory-only and view changes discard work
acceptance: Navigate A>B, use browser Back: A and its record/filter/scroll selection restore.
A copied URL or reload opens the requested authorized destination and record.
Leaving a dirty multi-field form preserves a draft or gives an explicit discard choice.
findings.limitations: Real browser Back/Forward/cancel/accept, Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape; late logout clears user-scoped views.

findings.title: Several lists render a blank region for zero rows
acceptance: Fixture 0 records and a nonempty collection filtered to 0 each render distinct messages.
No-results recovery clears the actual filters without initiating a write.
Loading/error/forbidden states are not described as an empty collection.
findings.limitations: Fixture zero/filter/error/403 plus measured main views; broader network matrix pending.

findings.title: EDI inspector calls generated example segments the raw transmitted payload
acceptance: A generated preview is visibly and accessibly identified as illustrative before copying.
If raw payload becomes available, display exactly that payload and clearly identify its version/source.
A 20-foot/reefer fixture never labels a hardcoded 45G1 example as its transmitted raw data.
findings.limitations: MOCK external provider; internal outbox, ACK and alert operations persisted; no actual external delivery claimed.

findings.title: Read-only page access still exposes write actions
acceptance: Read-only fixture users see viewing controls and clear permission context, no unusable write invitation.
Users/manage, roles/manage, billing/manage and tariff/manage controls follow exact separate permissions.
Backend authorization remains enforced on every command.
findings.limitations: Seven real UI accounts; custom roles and104 generated routes/102 single-decorator methods independently compared; exact/downgraded permission fixtures and real read-only notice. Full per-overlay role cross-product remains coverage UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Notifications panel lacks Escape and outside-click dismissal
acceptance: Open panel: trigger again, real Escape and outside pointer each close.
Escape returns focus to trigger; a visible touch close route stays reachable.
Click inside keeps appropriate content interactions working and does not lock the main page.
findings.limitations: Real browser four dismiss paths; asynchronous mark-read fixtures; unavailable count no longer announces zero.

findings.title: Shared header/layout repeat values outside existing tokens
acceptance: Affected consumers reference named tokens; literals are limited to token definitions and documented geometry.
Preserve existing layout and test both themes plus320dp/font scale1.5.
findings.limitations: Static styles and actual rendered heading style fixtures; geometry/reflow still requires native.

findings.title: Repeated metadata sizes bypass the type token scale
acceptance: No repeated arbitrary font-size literals remain in the affected metadata roles.
Screenshots show equivalent hierarchy before/after; scale changes need separate review.
findings.limitations: Source criterion; complete font/spacing matrix still pending.

findings.title: Default heading line heights exceed the project rubric
acceptance: Heading computed line-height is1.1-1.3 where the role applies.
Long headings do not overlap or clip at all tested widths.
findings.limitations: CSS and sampled computed headings; no claim all content role exceptions are audited.

findings.scope: Non-financial command guards and input preservation; deferred/rejected components verified.
Manifest/Role/Handover detail availability with stale/403 recovery.

findings.title: Partner API log JSON bodies crash the whole web app
Shared controls fall below Android target size
Semantic colors produce failing text contrast
No authorized tabs leaves the session without an account exit
Logout could be undone by a late token refresh or cleanup.
Loose DTO/pagination fallbacks invented financial/status/catalog data.
A previous session command closure could write after user switch.
String false in canGateOut was truthy and could authorize a gate-out command.
parseInt truncated backend-valid fractional payment values.
Newly refreshed already-expired pass could reuse stale clock and show QR/exit.
Role editor stayed writable after same-user permission downgrade.
Container detail could close or change context during unresolved Gate Pass creation.
Most operational dialogs do not establish modal keyboard behavior
Visible sibling labels are not associated with operational fields
Five master/detail lists use pointer-only clickable div cards
Payment and other asynchronous actions stay enabled while saving
Nested load failures silently become empty holds, passes or incomplete details
Late old cache writes/clears could remove a newer same-user cache.
Forbidden resource reads displayed zero revenue/capacity/unread counts.
MANAGER/read-only log readers were rejected by unrelated API-key management permission.
Opening an existing Gate-out pass also opened an unintended issue form.
A collection refresh reopened a dismissed Truck Visit create form and could overwrite its draft.
